page.overview:
Who is Enyo?

Enyo mainly ruled over war. However, she was only a minor war goddess as the main war gods were Ares and Athena. Enyo usually travelled with Ares and Eris into wars. Enyo was the bringer of devastation and destruction of cities as well as mass bloodshed.In the Iliad she was referred to as the waster of cities.

Enyo was usually only seen riding into war along with Ares, Eris, Deimos, and Phobos.

Enyo is usually depicted next to Ares, riding into war. She usually wore a helmet and was armed with a spear and torch.

The spear and torch were sometimes seen crossing as Enyo's symbol. She also had one sacred animal;
